reviews.title: Excellent camera, but the lighting is a bit harsh
reviews.comment:
The camera quality is fantastic. I tend to use other "warmer" lights or bounce them off the walls so it doesn't look like I'm being questioned by the cops nor look pale as a ghost ... I'm pale enough as it is. The microphone is also pretty darn good, though I also use an external microphone but could use this one and would be fine with it.
The software of this Razor LOVES to autofocus, especially if there is anything with writing on it in the background. It's weird because it's a webcam; it's not like I'm going to be 1 foot away and then like 30 feet away. You can set the focal range, but it will reset to "autofocus on all the things" depending on the application you use. For zoom, as that's often what I use it for, it always defaults to autofocus. It usually remembers to be in NOT autofocus mode for other programs, but I'm constantly turning autofocus off or can't trust that it IS off. The focal range is a little sensative and I had to write the setting for the focal range. It's got all these options for focus and lighting and sound but the autofocus is what makes it annoying.
If you're only going to use this for one program, like twitch (probably why lots of steamers use it) or you like autofocus for some reason, or your work space has you running into the background a lot, the autofocus is fine. I'm fine with having my zooms be a little shifty if my other recordings are crisp, but if you can't be bothered to change it every time, this is the one feature I'd want them to fix.
THIS SEEMS LIKE A SOFTWARE PROBLEM so can that just be patched?
reviews.author: Carl R

reviews.author: cam29

reviews.title: Solid 1080p Webcam With a Really Handy Ring Light
reviews.comment: This webcam works great for basic streaming, video calls, and everyday computer use. The 1080p at 30FPS looks clean and sharp, and the 720p at 60FPS is a nice option if you want smoother video for gaming or movement. The built-in adjustable ring light is the best part because it helps a lot in darker rooms and makes your face look way clearer without needing extra lights. Autofocus does a good job keeping things sharp most of the time, and setup is easy on both Windows and Mac. Only reason I’m not giving 5 stars is because being renewed can be hit or miss depending on what condition it shows up in, but overall, this has been a solid purchase.
reviews.author: Reader's Edyn

reviews.title: Good picture! Bright light.
reviews.comment:
The product was refurbished and recertified but it looks as if it was taken out the box 10 seconds and quickly returned. Completely unscratched and brand new looking.
The picture is great! solves the need for a ring light. the light itself is a little bright but you'll be okay if you don't go past the first setting. Setup is simple and straightforward, worked immediately on my Xbox One X!
reviews.author: Abel

reviews.title: My go-to for living remotely
reviews.comment: This has a couple great mounting options, and this became my household's go-to cam for shutdown. We've now got 3, and I've referred a few coworkers. Razer does have some extra video software for it, but you don't need to install it in order to use the cam. It's great. I'd give it an extra star just because I'm not forced to install more software.
